claims.claim: At least three people were killed in Kyiv in the Oct. 13-14 Russian strike; one person killed and more than 20 injured, with damage to residential buildings.
A ballistic missile hit the Darnytska CHP-4 power plant supplying Kyiv with heat and electricity.
At least 600,000 people across Ukraine were left without electricity after overnight Russian missile and drone strikes.
In Desnianskyi district, two bodies were found at a hit high-rise; 21 injured including a child; 16 residents rescued; a 400 sq m fire extinguished.
Desnianskyi district stood at 17 injured and two dead as of 09:00 Oct. 14, with 14 residential buildings damaged.
A Russian drone crashed in Kyiv's Pechersk District, injuring seven and hospitalizing three, and a later strike hit a Sviatoshynskyi District warehouse.
Ukraine's Air Force said Russia attacked overnight with 580 Shahed-type and other drones, neutralizing 536 across 31 locations.
At least 10 killed and 66 injured across Ukraine over the past day as drone waves struck central and western oblasts.
Russia said its massive strikes hit communications and energy facilities used by Ukraine's military, and claimed to down 900 Ukrainian drones overnight.
Russia accused Ukraine of attacking two oil refineries in Saratov and Ryazan in breach of the energy ceasefire; Zelenskyy adviser Dmytro Lytvyn called the claim fake.
claims.attributed_to: Russian Deputy PM Alexander Novak / Dmytro Lytvyn

claims.claim: SpaceX imposed an overnight 160 km/h Starlink speed limit that disrupted Ukrainian drone operations; SpaceX has not commented.
The full consolidated casualty count for Kyiv across Oct. 13-15 is not established.

claims.claim: Five killed and 36 injured in Kyiv since the evening of Oct. 13, per Kyiv police; figures carried by Ukrinform and Ukrainska Pravda.
claims.attributed_to: Kyiv police, via Ukrinform and Ukrainska Pravda

claims.claim: Three women aged 35, 58 and 84 killed in the Desnianskyi district apartment block, 25 injured there including a child; two more killed in Holosiivskyi district.
As of 08:50 Oct. 14, three women killed and 19 injured in the Desnianskyi evening attack, including a seven-year-old girl with cuts and burns.
State Emergency Service put it at three killed in Kyiv, 21 injured in Desnianskyi including one child, 16 rescued, and one killed one injured in Holosiivskyi.
claims.attributed_to: State Emergency Service of Ukraine, via Ukrainian Red Cross

claims.claim: At least three killed and 22 injured from the strike on the Desnianskyi residential building and power plants, per Mayor Vitali Klitschko.
At least nine killed across Ukraine in the Oct. 14 strikes: three in Kyiv, two in Dnipropetrovsk, one in Zaporizhzhia, three in Lutsk.
At least 17 killed and 67 injured across Ukraine as drone waves struck central and western oblasts, including three killed and six injured in Kropyvnytskyi.
No single consolidated Kyiv figure covers both the Oct. 13-14 missile attack and the Oct. 15 drone strike.

District-level injured counts differ between the district administration, State Emergency Service and the mayor (17 vs 21 vs 22 in Desnianskyi), reflecting different cutoff times and not reconciled in available sources.
No deaths reported in the Oct. 15 Pechersk drone strike; seven injured, three hospitalized.

claims.claim: Kyiv has not recorded a new death in the last 24 hours; the citywide figure remains five killed and 36 injured from the Oct. 13-14 missile strike, per Kyiv police.
Three women aged 35, 58 and 84 were killed in the Desnianskyi apartment block hit, with 25 injured there including a young child; two more killed in Holosiivskyi.
The Oct. 15 Pecherskyi district drone crash injured six people by 12:10 p.m., four hospitalized - a 68-year-old man and three women aged 24, 49 and 64.
claims.attributed_to: Kyiv police, via Ukrinform and National Police

claims.claim: Klitschko later put the Pecherskyi drone crash toll at seven injured, three hospitalized.
claims.attributed_to: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko, via Ukrainska Pravda and Radio Svoboda

claims.claim: No deaths were reported in the Oct. 15 drone strike on Kyiv.
claims.attributed_to: Kyiv police and Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko

claims.claim: At least 10 killed and 91 injured across Ukraine over the day to Oct. 14, as Russia fired 39 ballistic missiles and 128 Shahed-type drones.
Kyiv City Prosecutor's Office on Oct. 14 had at least four killed and 25 injured in the capital's overnight missile strikes.
claims.attributed_to: Kyiv City Prosecutor's Office, via Kyiv Independent

claims.claim: No consolidated Kyiv figure covers both the Oct. 13-14 missile strike and the Oct. 15 drone strike.
Prosecutor's Office Oct. 14 figure of four killed and 25 injured still sits below the police's five and 36 and is not reconciled in any source here.
